title: Lady Mira and the Golden Bell
moral: Do not give up, even small efforts lead to success.

scenes.summary: Lady Mira learns that the golden bell is missing and begins her journey.
scenes.text: Lady Mira lived in a bright castle and was known for being kind and brave. One day, the golden bell stopped ringing. She promised the king and queen that she would find it and set out on her journey with her pony Pepper.
scenes.image_prompt: kind knight girl in castle holding helmet with pony beside her colorful cartoon style
scenes.story: Lady Mira lived in a bright castle and was kind and brave. One day, the golden bell was missing and the castle felt quiet. She promised to find it and left with her pony Pepper. She met Gardener Bram who said the bell was not lost but quiet. In the village, a baker told her he heard a sound near the bridge. At the bridge, she found the bell stuck under wooden boards. She worked patiently and lifted the board to get it. She cleaned the bell and brought it back. Everyone was happy as the bell rang again, and Mira felt proud and hopeful.
